# Monero User Forum

> A community forum for discussing Monero (XMR): privacy, wallets, mining, nodes, merchants, and the broader Monero ecosystem. Part of the Monerica network. Private messages between members are end-to-end encrypted.

## Main pages
- [Home / recent discussions](https://monerouserforum.com/)
- [About](https://monerouserforum.com/about)
- [Contact](https://monerouserforum.com/contact)
- [Register an account](https://monerouserforum.com/account/register)
- [Sponsors](https://monerouserforum.com/sponsors)

## About this site
- Topic focus: Monero (XMR), a privacy-preserving cryptocurrency
- Part of the Monerica network: https://monerica.com
- Open source: https://code.monerica.com/monerica-project/monerouserforum
